title: Audio output device picker in Settings: app playback follows a chosen device, not just the Windows default
description: The app never calls setSinkId, so every <audio>/<video> and the toast chime follow the Windows default endpoint (on Fabio's box: SteelSeries Sonar - Gaming, which he does not hear). Add an output picker beside the Microphone setting, apply the choice to every media element from one place, and allow the speaker-selection permission in main.js.
